cards.card_text: God lists the garments: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban and a sash.
cards.verse_text: These are the garments that they shall make: a breastpiece, an ephod, a robe, a woven tunic, a turban, and a sash.

cards.card_text: They'll use gold, fine linen and blue, purple and scarlet yarn, and the ephod comes first, with two shoulder pieces and a woven waistband made all in one piece.
cards.verse_text: They are to make the ephod of finely spun linen embroidered with gold, and with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.

cards.card_text: The breastpiece is made with the same workmanship as the ephod, with gold, colored yarn and fine linen.
cards.verse_text: You are also to make a breastpiece of judgment with the same workmanship as the ephod.

cards.card_text: Then come braided chains of pure gold, gold rings at the corners, and a cord of blue yarn tying the breastpiece to the ephod so it doesn't swing out.
cards.verse_text: Then fasten the two gold chains to the two gold rings at the corners of the breastpiece, and fasten the other ends of the two chains to the two filigree settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.

cards.card_text: Next is the robe of the ephod, entirely blue cloth, with a woven collar around the opening at the top so it won't tear.
cards.verse_text: You are to make the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth, with an opening at its top in the center.

cards.card_text: The ___ bring the onyx stones and gemstones for the ephod and breastpiece, plus spices and olive oil.
cards.verse_text: The leaders brought onyx stones and gemstones to mount on the ephod and breastpiece, as well as spices and olive oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the fragrant incense.

cards.card_text: And the first holy garment on the list is the ephod.
cards.verse_text: Bezalel made the ephod of finely spun linen embroidered with gold, and with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn.

cards.card_text: Shoulder pieces get attached at two of the ephod's corners so it can be fastened on.
cards.verse_text: They made shoulder pieces for the ephod, which were attached at two of its corners, so it could be fastened.

cards.card_text: True or false: the ephod's waistband is woven as one piece with the ephod.
cards.verse_text: And the skillfully woven waistband of the ephod was of one piece with the ephod, of the same workmanship—with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

cards.card_text: The onyx stones go on the ephod's shoulder pieces as ___ stones for the sons of Israel.
cards.verse_text: Then they fastened them on the shoulder pieces of the ephod as memorial stones for the sons of Israel, as the LORD had commanded Moses.

cards.card_text: True or false: the breastpiece is made with the same workmanship as the ephod.
cards.verse_text: He made the breastpiece with the same workmanship as the ephod, with gold, with blue, purple, and scarlet yarn, and with finely spun linen.

cards.card_text: The chains run up to the ephod's shoulder pieces, and more rings go on the breastpiece's other corners and on the front of the ephod, just above the waistband.
cards.verse_text: Then they fastened the two gold chains to the two gold rings at the corners of the breastpiece, and they fastened the other ends of the two chains to the two filigree settings, attaching them to the shoulder pieces of the ephod at the front.

cards.card_text: So it won't swing out from the ephod So it can come off in a hurry So the stones won't scratch the linen
cards.verse_text: Then they tied the rings of the breastpiece to the rings of the ephod with a cord of blue yarn, so that the breastpiece was above the waistband of the ephod and would not swing out from the ephod, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.

cards.card_text: Next up is the robe of the ephod, the work of a weaver.
cards.verse_text: They made the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth, the work of a weaver,

cards.card_text: The robe of the ephod is woven entirely of ___ cloth.
cards.verse_text: They made the robe of the ephod entirely of blue cloth, the work of a weaver,

cards.card_text: Then comes the outfit, and it is a LOT of outfit: tunic, sash, robe, ephod, woven band, then the breastpiece with the Urim and Thummim placed inside.
cards.verse_text: He put the tunic on Aaron, tied the sash around him, clothed him with the robe, and put the ephod on him.

cards.card_text: From all of it, every earring and every ornament, Gideon makes an ephod.
cards.verse_text: From all this Gideon made an ephod, which he placed in Ophrah, his hometown.

cards.card_text: Gideon makes his ephod from all that gold.
cards.verse_text: From all this Gideon made an ephod, which he placed in Ophrah, his hometown.

cards.card_text: Soon all Israel prostitutes themselves by worshiping Gideon's ephod in Ophrah, his hometown.
cards.verse_text: From all this Gideon made an ephod, which he placed in Ophrah, his hometown.

cards.card_text: Micah has a shrine too, and he makes an ephod and some household idols.
cards.verse_text: Now this man Micah had a shrine, and he made an ephod and some household idols, and ordained one of his sons as his priest.

cards.verse_text: Then the five men who had gone to spy out the land of Laish said to their brothers, “Did you know that one of these houses has an ephod, household gods, a graven image, and a molten idol?

cards.card_text: So the priest takes the ephod, the household idols and the graven image and goes along, while the Danites put their small children, livestock and possessions out in front.
cards.verse_text: So the priest was glad and took the ephod, the household idols, and the graven image, and went with the people.

cards.card_text: The boy Samuel is ministering before the LORD, wearing a linen ephod.
cards.verse_text: Now Samuel was ministering before the LORD—a boy wearing a linen ephod.

cards.card_text: Ahijah is there too, a priest wearing an ephod.
cards.verse_text: including Ahijah, who was wearing an ephod.

cards.card_text: Ahimelech says the only sword at Nob is wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod.
cards.verse_text: The priest replied, “The sword of Goliath the Philistine, whom you killed in the Valley of Elah, is here; it is wrapped in a cloth behind the ephod.

cards.card_text: That day he kills eighty-five men who wore the linen ephod.
cards.verse_text: On that day he killed eighty-five men who wore the linen ephod.

cards.card_text: Quick side note: Abiathar son of Ahimelech, a priest, had brought the ephod with him when he fled to David at Keilah.
cards.verse_text: (Now Abiathar son of Ahimelech had brought the ephod with him when he fled to David at Keilah.)

cards.card_text: When David learns Saul is plotting against him, he tells Abiathar the priest, "Bring the ephod."
cards.verse_text: When David learned that Saul was plotting evil against him, he said to Abiathar the priest, “Bring the ephod.”

cards.card_text: Then David says to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, "Bring me the ephod." So Abiathar brings it to him.
cards.verse_text: Then David said to Abiathar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, “Bring me the ephod.” So Abiathar brought it to him,

cards.card_text: As the ark comes up, David is wearing a linen ephod.
cards.verse_text: And David, wearing a linen ephod, danced with all his might before the LORD,

cards.card_text: The singers and Chenaniah, the music director, wear fine linen too, and David adds a linen ephod.
cards.verse_text: David also wore a linen ephod.

cards.card_text: During those many days, Israel will still have its ephod and its idols.
cards.verse_text: For the Israelites must live many days without king or prince, without sacrifice or sacred pillar, and without ephod or idol.
